subject: Trial extension request for Heartwood pilot - procurement delay
messages:
From: Claire O'Neill <claire.oneill@heartwoodhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@heartwoodhealth.com
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0400
Subject: Trial extension request — Heartwood pilot

Hi Stephanie,

Quick note from procurement — our PO routing hit a snag in approvals and it looks like the pilot credits will not land until next Wednesday (8/19). The pilot environment is critical for our clinical ops demo next week and we are worried the timer will expire before finance can clear everything.

Is there any way Redwood can pause the countdown or grant a short extension/top-up so we don't lose the work we've been running? We're happy to provide the PO once approvals finish; internal legal asked for the exact invoice that will be issued.

Appreciate any help — Claire

Claire O'Neill
Director of Clinical Programs
Heartwood Health
claire.oneill@heartwoodhealth.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Claire O'Neill <claire.oneill@heartwoodhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 12:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Trial extension request — Heartwood pilot

Hi Claire — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the procurement headache. We can help keep the pilot live while your PO moves through approvals.

Options I can offer today:
- 7-day trial extension (timer pause) OR
- 5k token micro-topup to keep the key tests running through 8/19

If you prefer the extension I can approve that directly. The micro-topup requires a quick manager sign-off (Ben) because it touches promotional credits. Either way, please share the PO number or an expected approval date and I'll note it on our side. For legal, the invoice will come from Redwood Inference Inc.; I attached a short pilot summary PDF you can provide to internal stakeholders.

If you want me to loop in procurement contacts at Heartwood to accelerate, happy to do a quick intro.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive — Enterprise & Healthcare
Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0124

Attachment: heartwood-pilot-summary-v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 15:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Trial extension request — Heartwood pilot

Stephanie — thanks for flagging. Approve the 5k token micro-topup (promotional credit) for Heartwood as a one-off to preserve momentum. Please add this to the deal in HubSpot (note the PO will follow). If they ask for an extension instead of tokens, sign off on 7 days.

Notes for handoff: record credit as "HW-5K-AUG26" and log expiry date 2026-08-26. Camila, please prepare a quick success-check-in for 8/20 so we can capture feedback during the trial.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Claire O'Neill <claire.oneill@heartwoodhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, procure@heartwoodhealth.com
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 18:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Trial extension request — Heartwood pilot

Hi Claire — quick update: we approved a 5,000-token promotional top-up and also set a 7-day safety extension in case there are any further delays. That should keep your environment stable while your PO clears.

What I did:
- Issued promotional credit code: HW-5K-AUG26 (applied to your pilot namespace)
- Extended trial window by 7 days; new expiry: 2026-08-26 23:59 UTC
- Attached a short authorization PDF you can share with legal/finance.

Please reply with the PO number or an ETA when it's available and we'll replace the temporary credit. If you want an intro to our procurement ops person to speed sign-off, tell me the best time and I'll set a 15-minute call.

Thanks — glad we can keep the demo on track.

Warmly,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive — Enterprise & Healthcare
Redwood Inference
Attachment: trial-extension-approval.pdf (pdf)
